rendered: The document does not report any siRNA dose in mg/kg for this study — no mg/kg value appears anywhere in the text, and the passage on this work gives only formulation, model and outcome details.[1]What is stated is the LNP composition and molar ratio: and DMG-PEG2000 (in a molar ratio of 60:40:1) to construct LNPs[2] built encapsulating si-FOXM1 via the tert-butanol dilution method[3], and the in vivo result: In the[4] BT549 lung metastasis model, the LNP-siFOXM1 treatment group shows[5] a significant reduction in lung metastatic nodules, and combining with[6] anti-PD-1 therapy further enhances metastatic lesion clearance.[7] The corresponding entry in Table 2[8] likewise lists only the carrier, cargo, target, particle size and release mechanism — particle size 90–100 nm[9] with Intracellular/Lysosomal Escape[10] — and no dosing information. So the dose you ask about cannot be answered from this document; it would have to be read from the cited primary reference [55] Y. Gao, J. Li, M. Xu, Y. Liu, L. Guo, J. Li, Reprogramming tumour-associated[11] macrophages in breast cancer via si-FOXM1-loaded lipid nanoparticles enhances[12].
